from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Extracts the core financial figures from a single company's 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code of the company if provided")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2025 Q1'")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating Revenue (营业收入) for the period in Yuan")
    operating_total_cost: float | None = Field(description="Operating Total Cost (营业总成本) for the period in Yuan")
    financial_expenses: float | None = Field(description="Financial Expenses (财务费用) for the period in Yuan")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancialData]
